name: Stone Slab · Water
primary: A 5×5 slab that follows your view: look up for a roof over your head (3 blocks above your feet), down for a floor right under you, straight ahead for a 5-block deck forward at floor level. It can hang in mid-air and skips occupied blocks. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description:
A 5×5 slab that follows your view: look up for a roof over your head (3 blocks above your feet), down for a floor right under you, straight ahead for a 5-block deck forward at floor level. It can hang in mid-air and skips occupied blocks. Material: magic earth, permanent. On you:
• Soaked for 6 s and leaves a puddle
